_about: Windows Terminal settings the loader applies at every start (essentials step, setting autoInstallEssentials). Merged into the PC's own settings.json after a backup: globals, profileDefaults (= profiles.defaults), the profiles here (matched by guid), defaultProfile and the key bindings (matched by id or keys) are set; everything else there is kept (other profiles, schemes, actions). startingDirectory.prefer is used when that folder exists, else the kit's dev folder (D:\dev\git or C:\dev\git). The font is set once CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font is installed. Field reference: docs/architecture.md#windows-terminal-settings
